verdict.rationale: The public sos.wyo.gov site has a Forms section listing registered-agent forms such as 'Appointment of New Registered Agent and Office' and CRA cancellation. It also offers print-and-mail annual reports via the Annual Report Wizard, a downloadable notary application form, and an entity-type guide ('The Choice Is Yours'). The probe confirms the Business Center is reachable without a key, while online filing on wyobiz requires an account. missing for 10: explicit confirmation that the Forms pages download without login, evidence of formation forms (e.g., Articles of Organization) as downloadable PDFs, form-specific filing instructions, independent or hands-on corroboration.
